kind.instructions: Which kind of work does the goal ask for?

criteria.feature: add a new feature or capability to existing software
criteria.bugfix: fix a reported error, crash, hang, or broken behavior
criteria.review_findings: fix findings from a code review
criteria.finish: finish work that is already partly done or uncommitted in the tree
criteria.port: port a file or module from another language or codebase
criteria.remove: remove or delete a feature, page, flag, or subsystem
criteria.sweep: rename or scrub every mention of something across many files
criteria.investigate: read-only investigation, audit, or research that ends in a report or plan
criteria.verify: independently verify already-built work without changing it
criteria.commands: run the exact shell or git commands given and report their output
criteria.scaffold: build a brand new project, tool, or app from scratch
criteria.scoped_edit: one small edit in a named file, such as a unit test or doc comment
criteria.explain: explain what the repo is or what it contains
